div.div:
Why the customer does not wait for the card. The moment the purchase is confirmed, the cart becomes an order and the shop answers straight away. Approving the charge happens afterwards, on its own: the order sits as pending until the card provider replies, and is then confirmed or cancelled.
That is what the two box colours mean — white is a step the customer is waiting on, green is a step that runs after they have already been answered.

text.tspan: Why the customer does not wait for the card. The moment the purchase is confirmed, the cart becomes an order and the shop answers straight away. Approving the charge happens afterwards, on its own: the order sits as pending until the card provider replies, and is then confirmed or cancelled.
That is what the two box colours mean — white is a step the customer is waiting on, green is a step that runs after they have already been answered.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 2262px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2440px; margin-left: 2380px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #bdc7d4; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
What this process deliberately does not do. A refused payment does not spend the reward voucher: the voucher stays valid, because a refusal must not cost the customer their reward. A customer may rate any product, whether or not they bought it.
Points are spent the instant they are exchanged, but the voucher they buy appears shortly afterwards, so nothing is lost if that takes a moment. And once an order is confirmed or cancelled, a repeated answer from the card provider changes nothing.

text.tspan: What this process deliberately does not do. A refused payment does not spend the reward voucher: the voucher stays valid, because a refusal must not cost the customer their reward. A customer may rate any product, whether or not they bought it.

Points are spent the instant they are exchanged, but the voucher they buy appears shortly afterwards, so nothing is lost if that takes a moment. And once an order is confirmed or cancelled, a repeated answer from the card provider changes nothing.
